subject: Zenexis MAP Kickoff — Renewal + Usage-driven Expansion
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Torres <sofia.torres@zenexis.ai>, Max Patel <max.patel@zenexis.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Zenexis MAP Kickoff — Renewal + Usage-driven Expansion

Hi Sofia and Max,

Thanks again for the time last week. As Zenexis approaches its annual renewal, we'd like to put a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) in place to align stakeholders, hammer out a realistic timeline for signature, and map the usage-led expansion we discussed.

Attendees from our side:
- Karthik Iyer — Account Executive (primary renewal owner)
- Laura Bennett — Sales Engineering (technical validation + eval plan)
- Monica Patel — Customer Success (adoption & upsell lead)

Could you confirm the Zenexis stakeholders for the MAP and their roles? From our notes, please confirm:
- Sofia Torres — Head of Data Products (executive sponsor)
- Max Patel — ML Platform Lead (technical evaluator)
- Procurement contact / billing (please share)

Proposed high-level MAP milestones (flexible):
1) Week of Apr 13 — Align goals & stakeholders; finalize success metrics for evaluation
2) Apr 20–May 4 — Technical evaluation (test prompts, latency/cost checks, model fit)
3) May 5–May 18 — Usage review & pilot expansion scope (additional seats/models)
4) May 20–May 31 — Commercial review & signature

I've attached a short MAP draft (zenexis_map_draft_v1.xlsx) and a Q1 usage snapshot (zenexis_usage_Q1_2026.pdf) to seed the plan. Laura, Monica — feel free to add items or suggest edits.

Action items for this note:
- Sofia / Max: confirm stakeholder list and any procurement contacts by Mon Apr 12
- Laura: share an eval checklist and proposed test prompts by Tue Apr 14
- Monica: prepare an initial upsell hypothesis based on Q1 usage

Looking forward to getting this moving — suggest a 30-minute MAP kickoff next week (I put a few slots in a follow-up).

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Zenexis MAP Kickoff — Renewal + Usage-driven Expansion

Thanks Karthik — this looks good. Confirming stakeholders and roles from Zenexis:
- Sofia Torres — Head of Data Products (exec sponsor)
- Max Patel — ML Platform Lead (tech eval)
- Helen Cho — Procurement Manager (contracts & billing)
- Aaron Kim — Security Architect (we'll need him for brief SOC2/data flow review)

Helen is on cc. We'll aim to get the procurement timelines over to you by Wed Apr 15.

Two quick notes:
- On the evaluation: Max would like a short latency and cost test that mirrors our current 5M tokens/month baseline plus a 20% burst scenario.
- On expansion: we're especially interested in the embeddings/semantic search workflow — could Monica flag suggested starting KPIs for that?

I'll grab a MAP kickoff slot for Tue Apr 14 10:00–10:30 if that works.

Thanks,
Sofia

Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Zenexis MAP Kickoff — Renewal + Usage-driven Expansion

Great — thanks for the confirmations, Sofia. Tue 10:00 works for us; calendar invite sent.

Laura and I put together a short eval checklist and a proposed test harness for the latency/cost scenarios Max described. Attached:
- redwood_eval_checklist.pdf — test cases, acceptance criteria, and roles (SE owns test execution, Zenexis owns sample datasets)
- redwood_test_harness_config.json (attached as a stub)

Monica: for embeddings/semantic search KPIs, initial suggestion:
- Recall on top-5 retrieval > 0.75 for the annotated eval set
- End-to-end query latency P95 < 220ms for 1k concurrent queries
- Cost per 1M queries below the current benchmark we discussed (see Q1 usage)

I updated the MAP draft with these milestone owners and an initial timeline. Please have a look and either edit directly in Drive or tell me changes.

Next steps after the kickoff: SE test window (2 weeks), then a joint usage review where we align on expansion scope and pricing options. We'd like to have a commercial proposal ready by May 18.

Thanks all — see you on the call.

Best,
Karthik

Attachments: redwood_eval_checklist.pdf (doc), redwood_test_harness_config.json (config stub)

Quick update after our kickoff and review of the Q1 usage:
- I'm proposing an initial upsell package focused on embeddings and higher-throughput inference for your search workload:
  - Add 2x embedding-only model capacity (reserved burst slots) for 6 months
  - 10% discount on dedicated capacity if committed before May 31
- I'll draft a short adoption playbook tailored to your engineering org (onboarding checklist, internal comms, training sessions).

Action items captured (owner):
- Max: share a 2-week sample dataset and test credentials (owner: Zenexis) — due Apr 16 (pending)
- Laura: run baseline tests and share latency/cost numbers by Apr 28 (owner: SE)
- Monica: draft upsell package and adoption playbook by Apr 23 (owner: CS)
- Karthik: compile commercial options and a tentative timeline for internal approvals by May 4 (owner: AE)

I'll follow up with a short doc and a preliminary pricing matrix early next week. If procurement (Helen) needs any legal/contractual inputs sooner, happy to loop in our contracts team.

—Monica
